items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Little Mikey died, two Mikey died. Wake with them.

ctx.x: I don't know, but many of them wake with...

A whole lot of those fellas I don't forget, Gusu and... Got some, huh? A whole gang of most everything, everything in that time, in that class. They're not a man of no kind. Piano players, no. Little Mikey died, two Mikey died. Wake with them. Bob ran, the weak head Bob ran out. Who is that?
